purpose: Single auditable index of independent empirical holdouts, pre-outcome feasibility stops, and current documentary validation state. No entry changes the official 100-point score unless a separate future admission decision explicitly says so.

holdouts.finding: The independent 2020-to-2023 replication failed the preregistered support rule: top-quartile mean lift was 0.8288, Spearman was -0.3891, 2x concentration was 15.09 percentage points lower than cohort, and loss rate was 5.12 points higher. Historical promoter-extension coverage was zero, so no promoter inference is allowed at this anchor.

The current NSE shareholding metadata source did not retain chronology-safe pre-anchor rows for the deterministic 2021 probe, so institutional XBRL reconstruction could not be attempted without guessing archive paths or using post-anchor metadata.
Improved 5x concentration and mean return in the top quartile but materially worsened loss rate and had negative rank correlation.

The official pre-anchor XBRL taxonomy and context mappings cleanly support Mutual Funds, institutional Foreign Portfolio Investors and aggregate institutional shareholder count. However, after preserving the original 100-company sample and expanding to 350 outcome-blind companies, only 8 had all three mappings complete across five chronology-safe filings spanning the established 330-400 day four-quarter interval, below the minimum cohort 30.
Top quartile had lower mean return, lower 2x and 5x rates, higher loss rate, and negative rank correlation.
Recent growth, margin, leverage and coverage snapshot modestly reduced losses but selected fewer multibaggers and had neutral-to-negative rank signal.

The base growth-plus-financial-quality core was modestly positive at this anchor, but that finding subsequently failed the independent 2020-to-2023 replication. Adding promoter holding change increased 2x incidence but worsened mean return and increased top-quartile losses by 7.15 percentage points.
Only five companies had strict reviewable historic numeric capacity/order-book relation candidates versus the preregistered minimum cohort of 30.

After processing the complete already-prequalified document pool, 42 symbols had at least one strict relation but only 21 could possibly satisfy the frozen two-family eligibility rule. Because 21 is below the preregistered minimum of 30, the holdout stopped before review and before any 2026 outcome prices were loaded.

global_guardrails: Preregister predictors and evaluation rules before future outcome load.
Do not convert missing historical evidence to zero.
Do not relax eligibility or review rules to meet cohort-size targets.
A 4-quarter shareholding feature requires five chronology-safe snapshots spanning 330-400 days; irregular five-filing sequences are not treated as 4Q evidence.
Stop infeasible designs before outcome load rather than tune after results.
Keep raw exchange/XBRL/PDF evidence out of public workflow artifacts.
Automated documentary page candidates are not scores until the frozen relation/review gate approves them.
One holdout cannot mutate official RK-MIS pillar weights.
